about.description: ASET is an open, implementation-neutral specification for a machine-interpretable semantic Seed with a minimal authority-scoped UNKNOWN, ALLOW or BLOCK resolution nucleus.

abstract: ASET defines a minimal machine-readable, machine-interpretable, independently implementable and verifiable semantic vessel. Its operational nucleus recognizes exact-binding local Authority resolutions, while external mechanisms may discover or evolve candidate forms without acquiring recognition authority or semantic precedence.
